svg.title: AI-driven development and certifications
svg.desc: A binary star system: Claude Code at the core with GitHub Copilot as its companion, and a tilted MCP ring carrying satellites labelled codebase, tools and data, with packets flowing along it. MCP servers connect AI agents to codebases, tools and data across design, coding, testing and code review. Also: local RAG with LangChain, Ollama and ChromaDB, and Tesseract OCR. Certifications: Anthropic Claude Code in Action, Introduction to Model Context Protocol and Claude 101 (August 2026); Microsoft AZ-204 Azure Developer Associate, AI-900 and AZ-900.
svg.text: Claude Code and Copilot, wired by MCP.
MCP servers connect AI agents to codebases,
tools and data across design, coding, testing
